question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)

(4, 25, 6)

(8, 25, 3)
solution:
The logic followed here is : **(1st number × 3rd number) = (2nd number - 1)**

Given :

 
• (4, 25, 6)

​4 × 6 = 25 - 1

24 = 24 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (8, 25, 3)​

​8 × 3 = 25 - 1

24 = 24 (LHS = RHS)

So,

 
• Option - (1) : (3, 81, 6)​

​3 × 6 = 81 - 1

18 ≠ 80 (LHS ≠ RHS)

 
• Option - (2) : (7, 22, 3)​

​7 × 3 = 22 - 1

**21 = 21 (LHS = RHS)**

 
• Option - (3) : (12, 96, 8)​

​12 × 8 = 96 - 1

96 ≠ 95 (LHS ≠ RHS)

 
• Option - (4) : (14, 55, 4)​

​14 × 4 = 55 - 1

56 ≠ 54 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, **"Option - (2)"** is the correct answer.
